is_anopheles.evidence: The study tested Anopheles gambiae (Kisumu strain) and Anopheles coluzzii (VK5 strain) larvae (Page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study evaluated larval susceptibility to ivermectin and conducted species-identification PCR, but did not genotype any target insecticide resistance markers. References to kdr in the discussion (Page 8) are purely speculative.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable genotype counts, allele counts, or allele frequencies for target resistance markers are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Anopheles coluzzii F1 larvae were derived from field-caught gravid females collected in December 2022 and February 2023 in Kou Valley, Bama, Burkina Faso (Page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting laboratory bioassay experiments on larval exposure to ivermectin.

sub_country_location.evidence: Field mosquitoes were collected at Kou Valley, Bama, Burkina Faso (11° 23' 59" N, 4° 25' 46" W) (Page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Samples were collected in December 2022 and February 2023 (Page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine new collections in Bama, Burkina Faso for laboratory bioassays.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary files contain dilution diagrams and egg hatching rates, not target genotype data.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the comparative larval susceptibility and post-exposure effects of ivermectin on wild-derived (Anopheles coluzzii and Aedes aegypti) and laboratory-reared (Anopheles gambiae and Aedes aegypti) mosquito strains in Burkina Faso. No target insecticide-resistance markers were genotyped.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype any target insecticide-resistance markers (reports_target_markers = false).
Does not report extractable genotype data for target markers (reports_extractable_genotype_data = false).
